name: DuckDB Vectors MCP server
description: Serves hybrid semantic + exact-token search over a local DuckDB index as two tools: search returns ranked chunks (text and metadata), report introspects the index. Opening the store connects writable and ensures its schema, so a call can create the database file and its indexes. Embedding is local by default; a configured backend (for example Bedrock) sends the query text to that provider. External, opt-in, off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Both tools open the store writable and ensure its schema, so a call can create the database file (search and report are not guaranteed read-only); point the server at a pre-built index whose path is safe to create or touch.

search returns the indexed chunk text and metadata (not just match IDs) and report returns the database path and the indexed source paths, so enable only over a corpus whose contents and file layout are safe to disclose to the agent and model.
Embedding runs locally by default, but the default model downloads on first use if uncached (pre-cache for offline); the opt-in Bedrock backend instead sends each search query's text to AWS.
